title: Milo's Cafe: a neighborhood café with a patio that follows the sky
summaryLead: A one-page site for a Morrisville café: the menu, the patio and a way to order.
story: Milo's is a European-style café in Morrisville, NC, run by Menad and Liliana Haliche. People look it up for three things: what's on the menu, what it costs, and whether the patio is worth it today. We redesigned the site around those questions. The top of the page is an illustrated patio that follows the real weather and time of day. The menu is on the page, not in a PDF. Ordering is one tap away.

numbers.label: Best Sandwich Shop in the Triangle, N&O readers' poll 2026

goals: Put the menu and prices on the page.
Let people see whether the patio is worth it today.
Send them to order in one tap.

features.title: The patio, drawn live
features.text: The sun, clouds, rain and wind follow the real sky over Morrisville. A slider moves through the day.
features.alt: Milo's patio scene in the morning
features.story: A photo can't tell you if today is a patio day. This one can. If the weather feed is down, the scene falls back to a plain daytime sky.

features.title: Their story, up front
features.text: Who opened it, what they serve and the sandwich-shop award, beside a photo of the front door. A Pair it picker below suggests a food and drink for first-timers.
features.story: First-timers face a long menu and don't know where to start. Pair it picks from lists we chose by hand. No account, no tracking.

features.title: A menu you can search
features.text: Food and drinks, a meat-free filter, category jumps and a star on guest favorites.
features.alt: Milo's menu with Food and Drinks tabs
features.story: Menus usually live in a PDF nobody can search. Here each item is its own entry, so a new seasonal drink is one line to add.
